excerpt: We all use different agentic systems, bots, chats, and so on. One day I realized that I need to copy context between the apps. It is annoying. So I created a trivial local MCP which sits on top of SQLite and exposes Cypher so LLM can query anything. Also LLM can define a schema if it understands it needs new nodes or edges. How do I use it: 1. I've scanned all my documents and stored passports, driver licences and all kind of contracts for my apartment, insurance and so on. And not only mine - the entire family. 2. I've extracted all the key date and values. Also gemini extracted all the personal relations. Like "Alex is-a-child-of Bob". "Bob is-married-to Anna". So i can ask "give me a passport number of my son" and it gives it back instantly. It might not be a big deal, but it is very convenient. 3. It stores all the projects I'm working on, key steps and decisions. 4. And the most important thing - it works from anywhere. I can ask Hermes i telegram to remind me when my insurance ends or I can reference my project in ClaudeCode just by name and it will get the entire history from Antigravity. I would be happy if you guys find it useful.
